beginner.title: Get started with Acuity Scheduling
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Acuity Scheduling, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up your business
beginner.outcome: You can: configure Acuity Scheduling for your business
beginner.practice: Set up your profile and three services or products

beginner.title: Daily operations
beginner.outcome: You can: run day-to-day work in Acuity Scheduling
beginner.practice: Run one full day of operations in Acuity Scheduling

intermediate.title: Customers and data
intermediate.outcome: You can: keep clean customer and transaction records
intermediate.practice: Import or clean up your customer list

intermediate.title: Reports that matter
intermediate.outcome: You can: read the reports that guide decisions
intermediate.practice: Review last month's report and pick one action

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Acuity Scheduling
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Acuity Scheduling distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Acuity Scheduling
expert.outcome: You can: use Acuity Scheduling's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Scale and control
expert.outcome: You can: run Acuity Scheduling across a team or branches
expert.practice: Set up roles for staff and review the audit log

expert.title: Integrate Acuity Scheduling into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Acuity Scheduling with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Acuity Scheduling to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Acuity Scheduling well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Acuity Scheduling" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
